layout_and_navigation.main_content_area: pt-24 pb-28 px-4 sm:px-8 max-w-7xl mx-auto min-h-screen

cards_grid_image.usage: Displayed as top visual reference banner in Character Select, Weapon Arsenal, and Garage header. Individual cards built with live React components styled identically to the reference image.

progression_tiers_image.usage: Embedded in Character Progress / Tiers modal and detail panel showcasing rank milestones (Street Thug -> Enforcer -> Operative -> Kingpin -> Legend).

city_map_image_clean.usage: Interactive Map view background / overlay reference for the 7 Neon City districts (North, South, East, West, Downtown, Docks, Black Island).

city_map_image_nav.usage: Full HUD & Map integration mockup preview in game guide / overview tab.

heist_simulation_ticker_animation.engine: Framer Motion AnimatePresence with step-by-step automatic event interval
outcomes: PERFECT SUCCESS (+150% Cash, +200% Rep, 0% Health Loss)
PARTIAL SUCCESS (+50% Cash, +40% Rep, 30% Health Loss, +20% Heat)
FAILED ($0 Cash, -10% Rep, 50% Health Loss, +35% Heat)
DISASTER ($0 Cash, Arrested/Hospitalized, 90% Health Loss, +50% Heat)
heist_simulation_ticker_animation.audio_visual_feedback: Glitch effect transitions, screen flash in green on bypass, red pulse on alarm, victory neon popup modal with detailed breakdown.

general_ui_ux_guidelines.data_testid_requirement: EVERY interactive element (buttons, tabs, card selectors, input fields, heist triggers, inventory equip buttons) MUST include a kebab-case data-testid attribute. Example: data-testid='character-select-hacker-button', data-testid='bottom-nav-arsenal', data-testid='start-heist-button'.
general_ui_ux_guidelines.mobile_first_responsiveness: Grid fallback from 3-4 columns on desktop to 1 column on mobile screens; bottom navigation labels shrink to icons with subtle neon active dot on mobile.
general_ui_ux_guidelines.hover_active_states: Hover states must increase border glow brightness and scale element by 1.02x. Active states must show solid neon fill or inset glow.
general_ui_ux_guidelines.zero_transparent_dropdowns: All modals, tooltips, select menus, and popovers must have high-opacity solid backgrounds (e.g. bg-black/95 or bg-zinc-950) with 1px neon border. NO see-through unreadable dropdowns.

instructions_to_main_agent: Load Google Fonts in public/index.html with Orbitron, Rajdhani, Chivo, and IBM Plex Sans.
Build the persistent HUD with top fixed position containing Money, XP, Heat, Rep, Health, Level.
Build the bottom navigation bar sticky at the bottom with 9 neon icon buttons.
Implement persistent state using React context or local storage (email, user profile, money, items, crew, level, stats).
Integrate the 4 uploaded reference images in their respective screens (Character select banner, Tiers, Interactive Map district view).
Ensure all buttons and inputs have explicit `data-testid` attributes.
